title: Audio comparison pairing
responsibility: Finds unambiguous before-and-after audio pairs in recorded evidence.

inputs.name: audioPairs.items
inputs.description: The evidence records supplied for comparison. A record participates only if `evidenceMedia(item)` is `audio`, `comparison?.trim()` is nonempty, and `phase` is exactly `before` or `after`; grouping retains the original comparison string and uses `viewport || ""`.

outputs.name: audioPairs
outputs.description: A `Map<string, Evidence>` from each eligible group's after-record `id` to its before record. An entry is made only when the `[comparison, viewport || ""]` group contains exactly one before and exactly one after record; incomplete or duplicate groups are omitted.
